notes: 18.128 — the stack now actually stays up. KeepAliveService (the app's foreground service, the one supervisor Android cannot reclaim) previously watched only :3000 and :8787 and NEVER restarted the keeper or the watchdog. When both supervisors died, 15 of 17 services were left unsupervised and stayed down permanently — which is why 'servers are self-healing' kept being untrue. It now calls axzora-ensure.sh every ~30s (immediately when the core is down), which sweeps all 17 services AND restarts dead supervisors. Logic lives in a shell script so it can be fixed without an APK rebuild.
